reviews.decision: Do not rename the retained returned-map key. Both owned consolidated private-typography-to-2018-config bodies are byte-identical to untouched Material16, including font-famiy. Actual packed/untouched comparisons include the entire returned map from custom legacy and modern configurations, not only a font marker. The later current M2 inspection/versioning patch changes executable keys and is incompatible with the retained helper result. Preserve original null/modern-return branches and custom per-level font maps; this does not clear unrelated typography/companion/aggregate deviations.
